metadata.source_title: Evolution and Selection of Quantitative Traits

blocks.content: Similarly, the conditional fixation times are obtained using Equations A1.23a and A1.23b, with $$ h_{0}(x,p)=\frac{1-x}{1-p}h(x,p)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&4N_{e}&&for0<x<p\\ &4N_{e}\frac{p(1-x)}{x(1-p)}&&for p<x<1\end{aligned}\right. $$ for those paths leading to loss, and $$ h_{1}(x,p)=\frac{x}{p}h(x,p)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&4N_{e}\frac{x(1-p)}{p(1-x)}&for0<x<p\\ &4N_{e}&for p<x<1\end{aligned}\right. $$ for those paths leading to fixation. The integration of Equation A1.22b then yields an expected conditional time to loss of $$ \begin{aligned}\bar{t}_{L}(p)&=\int_{0}^{1}h_{0}(x,p)dx=4N_{e}\int_{0}^{p}dx+4N_{e}\frac{p}{1-p}\int_{p}^{1}\frac{1-x}{x}dx\\&=-4N_{e}\left(\frac{p}{1-p}\right)\ln(p)\end{aligned} $$ and an expected conditional time to fixation of $$ \begin{aligned}\bar{t}_{F}(p)&=\int_{0}^{1}h_{1}(x,p)dx=4N_{e}\frac{1-p}{p}\int_{0}^{p}\frac{x}{1-x}dx+4N_{e}\int_{p}^{1}dx\\&=-4N_{e}\left(\frac{1-p}{p}\right)\ln(1-p)\end{aligned} $$

These results were first obtained by Kimura and Ohta (1969a, 1969b). As a check of consistency, we can apply Equation A1.24, $$ \begin{aligned}\bar{t}&=u(p)\bar{t}_{F}(p)+\left[1-u(p)\right]\bar{t}_{L}(p)\\&=-4N_{e}\left[p\left(\frac{1-p}{p}\ln(1-p)\right)+(1-p)\left(\frac{p}{1-p}\ln(p)\right)\right]\\&=-4N_{e}\left[(1-p)\ln(1-p)+p\ln(p)\right]\\ \end{aligned} $$ which (as expected) recovers our expression (Equation A1.25) for the unconditional time t.

For the special case of a neutral allele introduced as a single copy, $ p = 1/(2N) $, which results in the approximations $$ (1-p)/p\simeq1/p=2N,\quad p/(1-p)\simeq p=1/(2N) $$ and $$ \ln(1-p)\simeq-p=-1/(2N),\quad\ln(p)=-\ln(1/p)=-\ln(2N) $$

If we use these approximations, Equation A1.25 reduces to $$ \begin{aligned}\bar{t}&=-4N_{e}[\left(1-p\right)\ln(1-p)+p\ln(p)]\\&\simeq-4N_{e}\left[-1/(2N)-\ln(2N)/(2N)\right]\simeq\frac{2N_{e}}{N}\ln(2N)\end{aligned} $$

Similarly, Equations A1.27 and A1.28 become $$ \bar{t}_{L}=-4N_{e}\left(\frac{p}{1-p}\right)\ln(p)\simeq\frac{2N_{e}}{N}\ln(2N) $$ and $$ \bar{t}_{F}=-4N_{e}\left(\frac{1-p}{p}\right)\ln(1-p)\simeq-4N_{e}(2N)\left(-\frac{1}{2N}\right)=4N_{e} $$
